data: Le Talent de mes amis (Thanks to My Friends)

Alex et Jeff, collègues de bureau dans une multinationale, sont aussi les meilleurs amis du monde depuis le lycée. Avec leurs femmes respectives, ils forment ensemble presque une famille, qui se fraye un chemin dans la vie, tranquillement, doucement, sans grande ambition. Pourtant l’arrivée de Thibaut, conférencier et spécialiste en développement personnel, ne va pas tarder à mettre à mal leur équilibre pépère. Et pour cause, Thibaut est un ami d’enfance d’Alex. À l’époque, ces deux-là, super complexés et toujours mis à l’écart dans la cour d’école, s’étaient promis de réussir leur vie, coûte que coûte. Aujourd’hui, le beau et brillant Thibaut semble pour sa part avoir tenu sa promesse et pousse Alex à réaliser ses rêves au risque de perdre l’amitié de Jeff... Mais sommes-nous tous voués à un destin exceptionnel ? (Alex and Jeff, colleagues in the office of a multinational firm, have also been best friends since high school. With their respective wives, they almost form a family, making their way through life, peacefully, gently, and without any great ambition. However, the arrival of Thibaut, a speaker and personnel development specialist, will soon play havoc with their quiet little lives. Thibaut is in fact a childhood friend of Alex. Back when they were kids, they were both highly uptight and always shunned in the school yard, and they vowed that they'd get ahead in life, no matter the cost. Now, handsome and brilliant Thibaut seems to have kept his promise and encourages Alex to fulfill his dreams at the risk of losing Jeff's friendship... But are we all destined for an exceptional destiny?)

Alex and Jeff, colleagues in the office of a multinational firm, have also been best friends since high school. With their respective wives, they almost form a family, making their way through life, peacefully, gently, and without any great ambition. However, the arrival of Thibaut, a speaker and personnel development specialist, will soon play havoc with their quiet little lives. Thibaut is in fact a childhood friend of Alex. Back when they were kids, they were both highly uptight and always shunned in the school yard, and they vowed that they'd get ahead in life, no matter the cost. Now, handsome and brilliant Thibaut seems to have kept his promise and encourages Alex to fulfill his dreams at the risk of losing Jeff's friendship... But are we all destined for an exceptional destiny?
